notes: Series and movie matching: OMDb and Trakt as optional extras. Add your own free OMDb key or Trakt client ID in Settings → Series and movie matching. Trakt links IMDb, TMDB and TVDB IDs and searches by title and year; OMDb checks the year and adds title, description, genres and poster. Both stay off without a key and come after the Plex/.nfo IDs, TVmaze and Wikidata; only folder names and IDs are sent.
